044public class ScientistAICoreIntel extends BaseIntelPlugin {
045
046        protected SectorEntityToken cache;

048        protected ScientistAICoreBarEvent event;
049        protected boolean keptPromise = true;
050        
051        public ScientistAICoreIntel(SectorEntityToken cache, ScientistAICoreBarEvent event) {
052                this.cache = cache;
053                cacheSystem = cache.getStarSystem();
054                this.event = event;
055                Misc.makeImportant(cache, "saci");
056                
057                cache.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$saic_eventRef", this);
058        }
059        
060        @Override
061        public boolean callEvent(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog,
062                                                         List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
063                String action = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
064                
065                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
066                CargoAPI cargo = playerFleet.getCargo();
067                MemoryAPI memory = cache.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
068                
069                if (action.equals("putValuesInMemory")) {
070                        memory.set("$saic_marketOnOrAt", event.getShownAt().getOnOrAt(), 0);
071                        memory.set("$saic_marketName", event.getShownAt().getName(), 0);
072                        memory.set("$saic_heOrShe", event.getHeOrShe(), 0);
073                } else if (action.equals("genLootWithCore")) {
074                        genLoot(dialog, memoryMap, true);
075                } else if (action.equals("genLootNoCore")) {
076                        genLoot(dialog, memoryMap, false);
077                }
078                
079                return true;
080        }
081        
082        @Override
083        protected void notifyEnding() {
084                super.notifyEnding();
085                
086                // actually, probably makes more sense as a one-off
087//              float timeout = 120f + (float) Math.random() * 120f;
088//              BarEventManager.getInstance().setTimeout(ScientistAICoreBarEventCreator.class, timeout);
089        }
090
091        protected void genLoot(final InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap, boolean withCore) {
092                OptionPanelAPI options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
093                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
094                
095                MemoryAPI memory = cache.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
096                long seed = memory.getLong(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SEED);
097                Random random = Misc.getRandom(seed, 100);
098                
099                DropData d = new DropData();
100                d.chances = 10;
101                d.group = "blueprints";
102                cache.addDropRandom(d);
103                
104                d = new DropData();
105                d.chances = 1;
106                d.group = "rare_tech";
107                cache.addDropRandom(d);
108                
109                CargoAPI salvage = SalvageEntity.generateSalvage(random,
110                                1f, 1f, 1f, 1f, cache.getDropValue(), cache.getDropRandom());
111                CargoAPI extra = BaseSalvageSpecial.getCombinedExtraSalvage(memoryMap);
112                salvage.addAll(extra);
113                BaseSalvageSpecial.clearExtraSalvage(memoryMap);
114                if (!extra.isEmpty()) {
115                        ListenerUtil.reportExtraSalvageShown(cache);
116                }
117                
118                if (withCore) {
119                        salvage.addCommodity(Commodities.ALPHA_CORE, 1);
120                        keptPromise = false;
121                } else {
122                        keptPromise = true;
123                }
124                
125                
126                dialog.getVisualPanel().showLoot("Salvaged", salvage, false, true, true, new CoreInteractionListener() {
127                        public void coreUIDismissed() {
128                                dialog.dismiss();
129                                dialog.hideTextPanel();
130                                dialog.hideVisualPanel();
131                                Misc.fadeAndExpire(cache);
132                                
133                                Global.getSector().addScript(ScientistAICoreIntel.this);
134                                endAfterDelay();
135                                cache = null;
136                        }
137                });
138                options.clearOptions();
139                dialog.setPromptText("");
140                
141                if (keptPromise) {
142                        if (random.nextFloat() > 0.5f) {
143                                SectorEntityToken loc = cache.getContainingLocation().createToken(cache.getLocation());
144                                spawnPiratesToInvestigate(loc, 50f + random.nextFloat() * 50f);
145                                if (random.nextFloat() > 0.5f) {
146                                        spawnPiratesToInvestigate(loc, 50f + random.nextFloat() * 50f);
147                                }
148                        }
149                }
150        }

153        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
154                
155                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
156                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
157                float pad = 3f;
158                float opad = 10f;
159                
160                float initPad = pad;
161                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) initPad = opad;
162                
163                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(mode);
164                
165                bullet(info);
166                boolean isUpdate = getListInfoParam() != null;
167                
168                initPad = 0f;
169                
170                unindent(info);
171        }

174        @Override
175        public void createIntelInfo(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
176                Color c = getTitleColor(mode);
177                info.addPara(getName(), c, 0f);
178                addBulletPoints(info, mode);
179                
180        }
181        
182        @Override
183        public void createSmallDescription(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
184                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
185                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
186                Color tc = Misc.getTextColor();
187                float pad = 3f;
188                float opad = 10f;
189                
190
191                CommoditySpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getCommoditySpec(Commodities.ALPHA_CORE);
192                if (spec != null) {
193                        info.addImage(spec.getIconName(), width, 80, opad);
194                }
195                
196                addBulletPoints(info, ListInfoMode.IN_DESC);
197                
198                if (cacheSystem == null) {
199                        return; // hack to make old save work...
200                }
201                
202                if (isEnding()) {
203                        info.addPara("You've found and looted the cache of pre-Collapse technology in the " +
204                                        cacheSystem.getNameWithLowercaseType() + ".", opad);
205                        if (keptPromise) {
206                                info.addPara("You've kept your promise to the scientist and placed the AI core in a secure " +
207                                                "container, to be shipped to " + event.getHimOrHer() + " as soon as you're back " + 
208                                                "in civilized space.", opad);
209                        } else {
210                                info.addPara("You've taken the AI core promised to the scientist for yourself. " +
211                                                "Surely, " + event.getHeOrShe() + " was no-one important.", opad);
212                        }
213                } else {
214                        info.addPara("You've learned that there is a cache of pre-Collapse technology to be found in the " +
215                                        cacheSystem.getNameWithLowercaseType() + ".", opad);
216                        
217                        info.addPara("The scientist that informed you of this wants the Alpha Core from this " +
218                                                 "cache as payment for " + event.getHisOrHer() + " services.", opad);
219                }
220                
221        }

279        
280        public static void spawnPiratesToInvestigate(SectorEntityToken locToken, float fp) {
281                
282                PatrolType type;
283                if (fp < AssembleStage.FP_SMALL * 1.5f) {
284                        type = PatrolType.FAST;
285                } else if (fp < AssembleStage.FP_MEDIUM * 1.5f) {
286                        type = PatrolType.COMBAT;
287                } else {
288                        type = PatrolType.HEAVY;
289                }
290                
291                FleetParamsV3 params = new FleetParamsV3(
292                                null,
293                                Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getLocationInHyperspace(),
294                                Factions.PIRATES,
295                                null, 
296                                type.getFleetType(),
297                                fp, // combatPts
298                                0f, // freighterPts 
299                                fp * 0.1f, // tankerPts
300                                0f, // transportPts
301                                0f, // linerPts
302                                0f, // utilityPts
303                                0f // qualityMod
304                );
305
306                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = FleetFactoryV3.createFleet(params);
307                if (fleet.isEmpty()) fleet = null;
308                
309                if (fleet != null) {
310                        fleet.addScript(new AutoDespawnScript(fleet));
311                        
312                        fleet.setTransponderOn(false);
313                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PIRATE, true);
314                        
315                        float range = 2000f + (float) Math.random() * 2000f;
316                        Vector2f loc = Misc.getPointAtRadius(locToken.getLocation(), range);
317                        
318                        locToken.getContainingLocation().addEntity(fleet);
319                        fleet.setLocation(loc.x, loc.y);
320                        
321                        TransmitterTrapSpecial.makeFleetInterceptPlayer(fleet, false, true, 30f);
322                        
323                        fleet.addAssignment(FleetAssignment.PATROL_SYSTEM, locToken, 1000f);
324                        //fleet.addDropRandom("blueprints_guaranteed", 1);
325                }
326                
327        }
